* December-January (2020-2021), February-March (2021), March (2021), and April-May (2021), where players had no later than June 30, 2021, 09:59 (EST), to redeem these Card Tickets before they expired.

* June-July (2021), July-August (2021), August (2021), November (2021), and December (2021), where players had no later than December 31, 2021, 09:59 (EST), to redeem these Card Tickets before they expired.
